feature: explicit Agent Skills catalogs, on-demand guidance and version-bound UTF-8 resources with independent operation approval
digest_method: SHA256 of compact ASCII JSON arrays of [POSIX relative path, SHA256 of bytes with CRLF normalized to LF], sorted by path; src/sprig_agent/*.py and tests/*.py separately

local_suites.command: uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv-wsl uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests -q

client_suite_command: uv run --project benchmarks/clients/mini --locked python -I -B -m unittest discover -s benchmarks/clients/tests -q

workflow_fixture.completed_pipeline: metadata only -> skill instruction load -> resource read -> actual resource in next provider request
workflow_fixture.incomplete_streams: no skill load or operation execution

packaging.isolated_installed_wheel_tui_smoke: passed: metadata -> skill -> script text -> actual script only after fresh command approval; draft and private resume retained without replay; installed offline CLI without a provider
runtime_dependencies_added: PyYAML 6.0.3 locked; safe YAML, bounded structure and no aliases

development_correction: Windows fixture write_text translated LF to CRLF, causing a large unittest string-diff recursion error. The byte-preservation case now writes explicit UTF-8 bytes and compares reassembled bytes; production reads preserve actual file bytes. Final full suites run after correction.

remote_ci.planned: manual native-regression.yml for exact functional SHA on windows-latest and ubuntu-latest; avoid full Python/client matrix

acceptance_scope: Protocol and interaction correctness; channel models are actual models regardless of billing; no requirement for extra paid-account tests
limitations: Platform skips are not passes; WSL is not a native Ubuntu CI runner
Explicit collection roots only, direct child SKILL.md; no recursive arbitrary Markdown discovery or link following
No skill installer, marketplace, implicit preapproval, automatic script or hooks/MCP backend
No new model coding-success, latency, token-cost or competitor-parity claim
